objective: Ultimo post-audit fisico READ_ONLY de Cavas BOS Persona link. Certificar exclusivamente que dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.PersonaID existe, es BIGINT NULL, existe exactamente una FK hacia dbo.Gobierno_Persona(PersonaID), existe indice sobre PersonaID, permanecen intactas las tres FK operativas de CavaSocios_Botellas/CavaSocios_Cargos/CavaSocios_Movimientos por SocioID, y los dos socios actuales permanecen con PersonaID NULL. No ejecutar DDL/DML, no modificar repositorio, no crear otra migracion y no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: gate12h3_column
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID'

queries.name: gate12h3_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND pc.name=N'PersonaID' ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: gate12h3_index
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_disabled FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY i.name

queries.name: gate12h3_children
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,pc.name AS child_column,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS parent_table,rc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') ORDER BY child_table,fk.name

queries.name: gate12h3_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personaid_null,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personaid_present FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
